title: add-version-pinning-and-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-private-installer
author: Nadia Park
ci_status: pass (integration retried once; e2e-helm flaky on k8s-1.26 fixed by pinning image)
description: Motivation: private deployments need a safer, operationally predictable upgrade path. This PR adds conservative version pinning, a downgrade guard, and end-to-end backup/restore and schema-migration safety checks to the private installer (Helm + Terraform modules + upgrade tooling). Goals: (1) prevent accidental downgrades when a customer rollbacks an installer, (2) make upgrades reversible where possible by ensuring backups and migrations are coordinated, (3) expose clear operator commands for pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade verification. What this changes (summary): - Helm: add chart-level versionPin value with templated behavior; charts now render resources that explicitly annotate installer-version and migration-version. - Terraform: pin module versions for 3rd-party providers and add a variable to lock Redwood operator image version during upgrade windows. - Upgrade tool: implement pre-upgrade hooks: snapshot-postgres (pg_dump + pg_basebackup support), s3-compatible backup manifest creation, and a preflight that validates schema compatibility against the target binary via a lightweight migration-dryrun binary. - Downgrade guard: install-time and upgrade-time check that prevents applying specs where the target version < current catalog version unless --force-downgrade is supplied with documented operator steps. - Restore flow: add restore command with clear ordering (stop services -> restore DB -> migrate to expected schema if needed -> restart services) and safety checks to avoid partial-restores. - E2E tests: add helm-upgrade-rollback pipeline that runs a three-step scenario: 1) deploy vA, 2) upgrade to vB with migrations, 3) attempt rollback to vA (should block unless --force). - Documentation and runbook: step-by-step upgrade/rollback runbook and troubleshooting section for common failure modes. Checklist: [x] Helm chart changes and values documented [x] Terraform module pins added [x] Backup/restore commands implemented and tested locally [x] Migration dry-run binary integrated [x] Downgrade guard implemented and tested in CI [x] Runbook and release notes written Backwards-compatibility notes: - Default behavior is conservative: if operator does not opt-into new behaviors (i.e. does not set versionPin or leave downgrade guard enabled), the installer behaves as before. Operators are encouraged to enable versionPin and the guard for production clusters. - Schema migration dry-run is read-only and safe; it does not modify DB unless run in apply mode. Upgrade path / operator instructions (short): 1) pre-upgrade: run `installer preflight --backup=./out --target-version=redwood@vB` -> verifies free disk space, PG snapshot, and writes manifest. 2) upgrade: `installer apply --chart-version=vB --version-pin=redwood@vB` 3) post-upgrade verify: `installer verify --smoke-tests` 4) rollback blocked by default; to force rollback: `installer rollback --force-downgrade --restore-manifest=./out/manifest.json` Testing notes: - Unit tests for template rendering and guard logic - Integration pipeline added: `ci/e2e/helm-upgrade-rollback.yml` that runs in parallel on k8s-1.25 and 1.26. - Manual test performed against a local Kind cluster and an internal QA cluster. Linear / tickets: ENG-3241 (upgrade/rollback tooling), ENG-3302 (downgrade guard), SUP-2218 (customer reported rollback incident that triggered this work). Risk and mitigations: - Risk: operators may incorrectly force rollback and cause incompatibilities. Mitigation: runbook + explicit `--force-downgrade` flag + warnings and confirmation prompt. - Risk: backups may be large and time-consuming. Mitigation: support incremental pg_basebackup and provide guidance for offline maintenance-window planning. Merge notes: squash-merged. Follow-ups: add scheduled automated backups to the installer and a restore-validation job that runs in a sandboxed cluster.

feat(terraform): pin provider/module versions and expose version_lock variable
feat(tooling): implement installer preflight backup and restore commands
feat(migrations): add migration-dryrun binary and integrate into preflight
fix(ci): add e2e helm-upgrade-rollback workflow and stabilize k8s-1.26 image pin
chore(docs): add upgrade/rollback runbook and release notes

Nadia Park: added migration dry-run test and updated runbook with estimated downtime heuristics (see commit).
Maya Lopez: requested that the default for versionPin remains empty so existing clusters are unaffected. Also asked to add telemetry event when --force-downgrade is used.

release_notes: Private installer: added optional version pinning for charts and operator image, new preflight backup/restore tooling, migration dry-run, and a downgrade guard to prevent accidental rollbacks. Operators should read docs/runbooks/upgrade-rollback.md before upgrading.
